title: PlanDiv: Test-Time Scaling with Latent Plans for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow

translated_title: PlanDiv：基于潜在计划的视觉-语言-动作模型测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过采样多个动作候选并执行其中最优的一个来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。我们发现，当候选动作从同一个解码器重复采样时，其收益会迅速递减：候选之间因噪声而非计划而各异，并且在三种重采样来源中，将候选数量从四个增加到八个，在CALVIN上平均完成任务数仅增加0.06-0.07。我们提出了PlanDiv，这是一种使候选动作因计划而不同的动作头：一个轻量级规划器提出K个潜在计划假设，一个共享的掩码扩散执行器在单次主干网络前向传播中为每个计划解码出一个动作块，策略执行其自身似然排名最高的动作块。这些计划仅从演示数据中学习，无需计划标签或奖励。在保持主干网络、数据和训练方案不变的情况下，八个以计划为条件的候选动作提升了CALVIN ABC→上的五任务链成功率
tldr: PlanDiv通过让测试时采样的动作候选因潜在计划而非噪声而不同——即在单次主干前向传播中由轻量规划器提出K个潜在计划并由共享掩码扩散执行器解码动作块——仅用演示数据学习计划，就显著恢复了VLA模型测试时扩展的收益。
en_tdlr: PlanDiv restores the gains of test-time scaling for VLA models by making action candidates differ by latent plans rather than noise, decoding K plan-conditioned action chunks in a single backbone pass with plans learned from demonstrations alone.
